Jl.bar_b_note: The B panel's hierarchy and gold ingredient lines come close to a shipping HUD, but the murky, flat, dark rainy world behind it has none of the Palworld-class colour or Valheim-class light.

Nu.bar_b_note: The Stormcapra fleece, horns and scale against the ruler hold up to the Palworld bar, but on a bare neutral stage there is no sky, fog or time-of-day grade to carry Valheim-class atmosphere.

Km.bar_b_note: B's blue-and-coral finned body reads well, but A loses its material in faint end and both sides have broken faint poses, and the neutral stage has no atmosphere.

Wm.bar_b_note: The Tanglevolt wolf matches the owner's style bar, but the frames are tiny and set on a neutral stage, so there is no light or weather to compare.

Uw.bar_b_note: The warm, appealing elder with clear eyes and an earthy green-and-brown outfit would sit next to Palworld's NPCs, though the neutral backdrop gives no atmospheric context.

Wf.bar_b_note: The Stormursa fur and violet lightning veins are on-bar, but the twisting hit react reads as overlapping bodies and the stage has no atmosphere.

Bk.bar_b_note: This is a naturalistic, well-proportioned wolf, but its near-black value sinks into the dark backdrop and the fainted body becomes a shapeless dark mass.

Ca.bar_b_note: The boar's fur reads naturally, but it stands shorter than the 1.80 m trainer, so it reads as livestock rather than a Palworld-scale creature.

Gg.bar_b_note: The teal otter and its ridden pose read clearly, but its uniform, slightly plastic surface and the lack of any atmosphere keep it short of shipping finish.

top_changes.change: Fix the broken faint and hurt states: Km A faint end swaps to an untextured grey-brown material and its hit react matches standing; Km B faint end pitches nose-down with the tail up; Nu B faint mid/end reads as a body flipped inside out; Wf's hit react reads as overlapping torsos. Keep the materials, ground every faint pose, and make each hit react visibly different from standing.
Ship the Jl side-B craft panel layout, and make the Craft and Leave hints controller-glyph buttons with teal highlights at a larger size so they read on a 7-inch screen.

Fix creature scale and value against the ruler: scale the Ca boar up until it clearly stands above the 1.80 m trainer, and lift the dark Bk wolf off the dark backdrop with a rim or key light and a lighter fur value.
